body.heading: Find a busy spot
paragraphs: With your adult, find a place where insects visit: a flower, a log, a patch of grass.
Settle down a little way away. Quiet watchers see the most.

body.heading: Watch them work
paragraphs: Follow one visitor with your eyes. Where is it going? What is it carrying?
Draw your visitor when you get home, with all its legs in the right places.

takeaway: Tiny creatures are busy neighbours, and watching is kinder than touching.
safetyNotes: Look only: never touch insects, and wash hands after being outdoors; leave every creature where it lives.
screenFreeExtension: Draw a visitor map showing where each tiny visitor was working.
